90.literal: Just bringing along a bunch of different women is enough to get you spending money,
90.official: So, if you show up with a pack of girls every time the bosses invite you drinking, they remember you. Half the time they give me cash on the spot.

91.literal: There's no point if you don't claw your way to the top.
91.official: If you're in this business, you've gotta claw your way up that ladder using any means possible. Right?

92.literal: Tonight you're keeping me company till the bitter end.

94.literal: (I wonder what kind of trick is going on here...)

96.literal: If I'm good enough, I'll hear you out, yeah?
96.official: I can't promise much, but I'm happy to lend you an ear.

97.literal: I've got a favor to ask you, boy!
97.official: Anyway, I had a favor I wanted to ask you.

98.literal: Hey, old man... is this the guy?

99.literal: Yes! He's my pupil, you know!

102.literal: Better hand over the cash before you get hurt — for your own good, right?

103.literal: Don't drag me into your messy business.
103.official: I told you, this has got nothing to do with me.

104.literal: So basically, you don't have the confidence, huh?

105.literal: ...Trying to rile me up like that won't get you anywhere.

106.literal: Pay your own damn debt yourself.

107.literal: There's guys like that a dime a dozen in this world, you know?

109.official: I feel terrible, just terrible for all the hassle I caused.

110.literal: Two million!? Like I'd trust a story like that!
110.official: You wanna pay me double!? Like I'm gonna buy that!

111.official: You're drunk off your ass, old man!

113.literal: That guy back there will do the fighting,
113.official: You have your tank back there fight us for it.

114.literal: But if we win, we're not paying.
114.official: We win, and we don't owe you a thing.

115.literal: Even the three of you together couldn't beat him, you know?

116.literal: Just so you know, I've got no intention of helping.

117.literal: Kamoji-kun just has to try a little, that's all.
117.official: Ah, no. Kamoji-kun, you sit this one out. I'm calling the round as your manager! Let the kid take it from here.

118.literal: You, boy, keep an eye on Kamoji-kun's moves.

119.literal: An amateur shouldn't push himself too hard.

120.literal: His punches aren't landing at all, huh.
120.official: Bruno barely got a punch in!

122.literal: You're still going with those pathetic punches?

123.literal: Heh... Guess it can't be helped.

124.literal: I didn't have the slightest bit of motivation, but...

125.literal: Once I saw his moves, I changed my mind...

127.literal: Wha... Bruno's getting beaten this one-sidedly...

128.literal: Just who the hell are you?

129.literal: Eh, oh, you were an actual yakuza...!?

130.literal: We're— I mean, we're from Toko Credit.

132.literal: In that case, I think he's at the office right now.
